core_obligations: For a covering, write down the exact sequence of low degree terms relating the first Cech group, the first cohomology group and the zeroth Cech cohomology of the sheafified first cohomology presheaf, which gives injectivity (proof lines 2650-2657).
Reduce surjectivity to the statement that a section of that presheaf over a covering vanishes after refinement (proof lines 2657-2659).
Establish that vanishing from the fact that the sheafification of the presheaf of first cohomology is zero, which is locality of cohomology (proof lines 2660-2663).
proof_roadmap: Injectivity from the low degree exact sequence (proof lines 2650-2656).
Surjectivity reduced to a refinement statement (proof lines 2657-2659).
The refinement statement from locality of cohomology (proof lines 2660-2663).
difficulty_reason: For a topological space X and an abelian sheaf F, the lemma shows that the comparison map from the first Cech cohomology group to the first cohomology group is an isomorphism (statement lines 2642-2647). The proof uses the exact sequence relating the Cech group of a fixed covering to cohomology and to the zeroth Cech cohomology of the sheafified first cohomology presheaf, which gives injectivity immediately (proof lines 2650-2657). For surjectivity one must show that any section of the presheaf of first cohomology over a covering becomes zero after refinement, which the author reads off from the vanishing of the sheafification of that presheaf by locality of cohomology (proof lines 2657-2663). The claim is H2: a two-line reduction to the low degree terms of a spectral sequence, with the locality of cohomology as the single input doing the work.
